name: remote-proxy
description: A local HTTP proxy shared by connected SSH and Dev Container windows, with no permanent service.

commands.title: Remote Proxy: Attach this remote window
Remote Proxy: Disable for this host

remoteProxy.localProxyPort.description: 0 uses the built-in direct HTTP proxy. Set an existing local HTTP/mixed proxy port (for example Clash 7890) to forward it instead. SOCKS-only ports are not supported.

remoteProxy.sshConfigFile.description: Optional local SSH config path. Otherwise use remote.SSH.configFile, then ~/.ssh/config. Supports ~/.

remoteProxy.hosts.description: SSH Host aliases enabled for automatic proxy connections. Use exact aliases from your local SSH config, not IP-to-user mappings.

remoteProxy.windowBindings.description: Remote authorities explicitly bound using the Attach command.

remoteProxy.authentication.description: Password asks on each new proxy SSH connection without saving it; key uses the local SSH agent/key non-interactively.

remoteProxy.remotePort.description: Remote loopback HTTP proxy port. Dev Containers must share the host network.
